name: Sanford Burnham Prebys Functional Genomics Core: Beckman Coulter Biomek i7 Hybrid (NIH S10; 2024)
brief: A functional genomics core replaces two ageing liquid handlers with one fully automated workstation having eight independent pipettes plus interchangeable 96- and 384-channel heads, to build arrayed CRISPR libraries and run cell-based screening pipelines.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for one workstation; any institutional match, service contract or integrated peripherals are not stated.

notes: Out-of-sample: found after the cost model was frozen at commit 02d7678 and scored blind against it (results in docs/validation.md). Later model or catalog changes do not count as out-of-sample for this case. price_basis=configured, from the wording of a grant to buy a complete working "fully automated system" (set before looking at catalog prices). Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10OD036254-01, award_amount 594187; https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/10852179). Quote: "the SBP Functional Genomics Core Facility seeks funding to acquire the Beckman Coulter Biomek i7 Hybrid automated workstation. This fully automated system, with 8 independent pipettes and interchangeable 96 and 384-multichannel liquid handling platforms...". 1 of 1 items maps to beckman_biomek_i7 (exact; catalog adds enclosure). Caveat: the S10 award may differ from the invoice.
